title: Handling of network rejection due to ESM cause #26

entities.name: Insufficient resources
entities.description: ESM cause value #26 indicating insufficient network resources.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE
entities.description: Information Element carrying the timer value for T3396.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator IE
entities.description: Information Element indicating re-attempt behavior, ignored in this clause.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Back-off timer controlling UE re-attempts for PDN connectivity and bearer resource requests.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Message rejecting attach procedure, may be integrity protected or not.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE is not registered.

entities.name: Timer value neither zero nor deactivated
entities.description: Condition where T3396 timer value is positive and active.

entities.name: Timer value deactivated
entities.description: Condition where T3396 is deactivated, blocking requests until specific events.

entities.name: Timer value zero
entities.description: Condition where T3396 timer value is zero, allowing immediate re-attempts.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT not integrity protected
entities.description: Condition where ATTACH REJECT message lacks integrity protection.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT integrity protected
entities.description: Condition where ATTACH REJECT message is integrity protected.

entities.name: Block requests until timer expiry or stop
entities.description: UE behavior to block specific PDN connectivity and bearer resource requests while T3396 is running or deactivated.

relations.description: ESM cause #26 triggers evaluation of Back-off timer value IE.
Back-off timer value IE provides the value to start timer T3396.
Condition stops running T3396 before starting it with new value.
Condition establishes blocking of requests until T3396 expires or stops.
Condition establishes indefinite blocking of requests until specific events.
Condition stops T3396 and allows immediate re-attempts.
Condition starts T3396 with random value from default range.
Condition starts T3396 with value from Back-off timer value IE.
T3396 continues running if UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
ATTACH REJECT message guards behavior based on integrity protection.
